passwords.description: Save logins in an encrypted vault that opens with a master password, Windows Hello or both.
passwords.warning_text: This password vault is new and has not been reviewed by an independent security auditor. Do not rely on it as the only copy of important passwords.
passwords.private_unavailable: The password vault is not available in private windows.
passwords.desktop_required: The password vault needs the desktop app.
passwords.setup_description: Choose how the vault opens. Spark cannot recover a master password for you, but you will also get a recovery key.
passwords.recovery_text: This key opens the vault if you forget the master password. It is shown only once and Spark does not keep a copy. Store it somewhere safe, away from this computer.
passwords.unlock_description: Unlock the vault to see your passwords.
passwords.reset_title: Erase the vault and start over
passwords.reset_warning: This permanently deletes every saved password. Only do this if you lost both the master password and the recovery key.
passwords.error_throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
passwords.error_generic: The vault could not complete that action.
passwords.error_invalid_entry: Check the fields: a title is required and some text is too long.
passwords.error_password_invalid: The master password must have 8 to 256 characters.
passwords.error_corrupt: Some vault data is damaged and could not be read.
passwords.copied: Copied. The clipboard is cleared in 30 seconds.
passwords.method_hello_hint: Your PIN, fingerprint or face. Works only on this computer and this Windows account.
passwords.method_none: Choose at least one way to unlock the vault.
passwords.hello_only_warning: Without a master password, only Windows Hello and the recovery key open this vault. If this Windows account changes, you will need the recovery key.
passwords.notice_password_on: The master password is now on.
passwords.notice_password_off: The master password is now off.
passwords.error_hello_failed: Windows Hello could not open the vault. Use the master password or the recovery key.
passwords.error_hello_unavailable: Windows Hello is not available on this computer.
passwords.error_method_unavailable: The vault does not use that way of unlocking.
passwords.error_method_already_on: That way of unlocking is already on.
passwords.error_last_method: Keep at least one way to unlock on (the recovery key does not count).
passwords.require_hello_title: Use Windows Hello when showing or copying passwords
passwords.require_hello_description: If you share this computer, Windows Hello confirms it is you every time you show, copy or export a saved password.
passwords.require_hello_needs: Turn on Windows Hello as a way to unlock first.
passwords.unlock_hello_description: Opens the vault with your PIN, fingerprint or face. Only on this computer and this Windows account.
passwords.unlock_password_description: At least one of these two must stay on. The recovery key always works, but does not count.
passwords.import_description: To add passwords from another browser, choose the CSV file it exported.
passwords.import_result: {imported} added, {duplicates} already in the vault, {skipped} left out.
passwords.export_description: The file is not encrypted: anyone who opens it can read your passwords. Delete it as soon as you are done.
passwords.delete_description: Every saved password and the recovery key are permanently deleted from this computer.
passwords.error_hello_required: Windows Hello is needed for this. Try again.
passwords.error_import_invalid: That file is not a password export (CSV with a password column).
passwords.error_import_too_large: That file is too large to import.
passwords.error_import_failed: The file could not be read.
passwords.error_export_failed: The file could not be saved.
passwords.recovery_download_note: The file is not encrypted: keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer (for example a USB drive), and do not leave it in Downloads.
passwords.recovery_saved: Recovery key saved to the file.
passwords.error_save_failed: The file could not be saved.
